title: Collection Cycles — Q3-Q4 2026
introduction: These are the current collection-development and curation priorities for the BTAA-GIN collection.

focus_areas.title: Existing BTAA scanned map collections
focus_areas.goal: Improve the accessibility and usability of existing BTAA library map collections.
items: Complete the evaluation and analysis of existing BTAA library maps.
Fix as many thumbnail and preview omissions as possible.
focus_areas.outcome: A stronger existing BTAA Library map collection and a repeatable process for future reviews.

focus_areas.title: Urban Base Layers
focus_areas.goal: Grow archive of municipal datasets in phases with Team Member cohorts
focus_areas.outcome: Archived data for two cities per each BTAA state.

workstreams.title: Cohort 2
items: Archive datasets for two cities in states that were not part of Cohort 1.

workstreams.title: Cohort 3
items: Archive datasets for a second city in states that were part of Cohort 1.

focus_areas.title: New Member and New Geography Integration
focus_areas.goal: Make sure recently added institutions and their regions are represented in the Geoportal.

workstreams.title: USC / California
items: Review and index the California state clearinghouse.
Index a small number of county sources and the Los Angeles open data portal.
Index a map collection hosted at USC.

workstreams.title: University of Washington and University of Oregon
items: Index university-hosted scanned map collections from each institution.

workstreams.title: Purdue and University of Iowa
items: Check with new team members about collections or resources they consider priorities.

focus_areas.outcome: Each BTAA member has an identifiable presence in the collection.
